## Summary

Describe the user-visible or maintainer-visible change.

## Why

What problem does this solve?

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests/validation run
- [ ] n8n workflow JSON still imports successfully, if changed
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, personal email addresses, chat IDs, private URLs, or real application data are committed
- [ ] Public configuration remains generic and UAE-wide
- [ ] Documentation matches the implemented behavior
- [ ] No job-site scraping or automated login behavior was introduced

## Agent gates

- [ ] **Foxory Builder / Foxory n8n**: implementation complete
- [ ] **Foxory Reviewer**: blockers resolved
- [ ] **Foxory Docs**: user-facing documentation current
- [ ] **Foxory Release**: release impact assessed when applicable

## Risks / limitations

List known limitations, migration concerns, privacy implications, or follow-up work.
